subject: Next steps / SLA: Erasure scope, backups & proof of deletion (FinApps)
content:
From: Ben Carter <ben@redwood.com>
To: Alice Morgan <alice@finapps.io>, FinApps Security <security@finapps.io>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica@redwood.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 12 Jan 2026 15:02:00 -0800
Subject: Next steps / SLA: Erasure scope, backups & proof of deletion (FinApps)

Hi Alice / FinApps team — thanks again for the call today. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we have alignment before we loop Privacy & Security teams in: 

Summary of the ask (from call)
- FinApps needs a documented RTBF workflow for customer-initiated deletion requests: scope, timeline, and evidence.
- Primary concerns: PII deletion, backups/snapshots, audit and request logs, and data residency (EU).
- You asked about SLA options for hosted vs dedicated deployments and whether backups can be purged faster for committed customers.

Ben's preliminary answers (high level)
- Active primary-store deletion: we can remove customer data from primary application databases within 24–48 hours of a validated request.
- Application logs / request traces: sensitive payloads are redacted; we retain metadata for operational debugging — retention configurable (default 90 days).
- Backups & snapshots: standard full-snapshot retention is 30 days (daily deltas) in our hosted offering. Immutable backups may require manual purge and legal review; this is the area that drives multi-week windows in many customers.
- Proof of deletion: we can provide deletion manifests and hashes for primary stores; for backups we can provide timestamps of purge actions and the supporting runbook.

Attachments: RTBF_Process_Summary.pdf (prelim; internal-facing), linking a high-level flow that I asked Security to confirm.

Proposed next steps
1) I’ll connect your security contact with our Privacy/PrivacyOps (Monica + Rishi) for a focused 45-min technical deep-dive next week to map the exact retention windows and any exceptions.
2) Please send your canonical retention policy or a short doc with any regulatory constraints (thanks for flagging the EU residency requirement).
3) We’ll surface options: hosted standard, hosted with expedited backup purge (contracted), and Dedicated where retention can be fully controlled by FinApps/committed schedule.

Can you confirm availability for a follow-up deep-dive sometime Wed/Thu next week?

Best,
Ben Carter
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
ben@redwood.com | +1 415-555-0192

From: Alice Morgan <alice@finapps.io>
To: Ben Carter <ben@redwood.com>
Cc: FinApps Security <security@finapps.io>
Date: Mon, 12 Jan 2026 18:10:12 -0000
Subject: Re: Next steps / SLA: Erasure scope, backups & proof of deletion (FinApps)

Ben — thanks for the quick recap. A few clarifying Qs from our side: 

1) Backups: when you say 30 days, is that from snapshot completion or from the moment we request deletion? If a customer requests deletion on day 2 of a 30-day snapshot cycle, can the relevant snapshots be targeted and removed sooner?

2) Immutable/air-gapped copies: we may have contracts that require retention. How do you reconcile the RTBF with contractual obligations for retention?

3) Proof/evidence: we need an auditable report we can give our internal auditors showing the data identifiers removed, time, and the storage locations. Is the deletion manifest you referenced machine-readable (CSV / JSON)?

4) EU residency: will deletion activity be executed in-region or will it involve cross-border operations? Our legal team will want to know for compliance.

Attached: finapps_retention_policy.docx (our internal outline).

—Alice
Alice Morgan
Head of Security | FinApps, Inc.
alice@finapps.io

From: Ben Carter <ben@redwood.com>
To: Alice Morgan <alice@finapps.io>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica@redwood.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 13 Jan 2026 09:30:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Next steps / SLA: Erasure scope, backups & proof of deletion (FinApps)

Thanks Alice — good questions. I wanted to give a concrete, transparent response ahead of the deep-dive so you have something to share with Legal: 

Answers at a glance
- Snapshot targeting: For hosted customers we can identify snapshots that contain the customer's data and schedule targeted deletion; timing depends on snapshot lifecycle and whether the snapshot has been replicated. For typical daily snapshot cadence we can often remove target snapshots within 72 hours of a validated request, but that is an expedited manual purge and would be part of a contracted SLA.
- Immutable copies: If a customer has contractual obligations requiring retention (or if snapshots are archived to an immutable store), we need to reconcile contract vs RTBF. This frequently requires an exception process: either a contractual amendment or a legal hold removal request from the customer.
- Deletion manifests: Yes — we can provide a machine-readable deletion manifest (CSV/JSON) that lists object identifiers, storage paths, timestamps, and SHA256 confirmation hashes where applicable. For backups, manifests will show the snapshot id and the purge timestamp.
- In-region execution: For Private/Dedicated deployments we can guarantee in-region execution. For hosted EU-region customers, all deletion activities for data resident in the EU are executed in the EU region; cross-border operations only occur for any support processes that require copies (we can avoid this on a per-customer basis with additional contractual controls).

Attached: rtbf_summary_for_finapps.pdf (updated with SLA tiers and an expedited purge option).

Next step: I’ll set up the technical deep-dive with Monica and Rishi. During that call, PrivacyOps will outline the exact API/requests, verification artifacts, and a proposed timeline for full purge including any backup exceptions.

Would Wednesday 14th at 09:00 CET / 00:00 PST work for your security team?

Best,
Ben

From: Ben Carter <ben@redwood.com>

Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>

Subject: FW: Next steps / SLA: Erasure scope, backups & proof of deletion (FinApps)

Monica / Rishi — looping you in after the initial discovery with FinApps. They are an EU-resident customer and are looking for: 

- Confirmed RTBF workflow that includes primary-store deletion, targeted snapshot purges, and a manifest for auditors.
- An expedited backup purge SLA option (contracted) — likely paid add-on; they want a clear maximum window.
- Proof-of-deletion artifacts (machine-readable) and runbooks that Legal can review.

Action items
1) Monica: can you prepare a brief (one-pager) that outlines the API/commands we will execute for a validated delete request, the manifest format (CSV/JSON example), and any limitations for hosted vs dedicated? Put the doc in the Drive folder and link it in the HubSpot deal.
2) Rishi: please confirm whether our standard hosted snapshot lifecycle can be targeted and purged within 72 hours if needed and outline any engineering gating (replication, vendor snapshots). If we need manual engineering involvement, estimate effort and an SLA tier.
3) Marissa: finance — please draft a pricing option for an expedited backup purge add-on (month-to-month and annual committed pricing).

Related links: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1a2b3c-finapps-rtbf, HubSpot deal: https://hubspot.redwood.com/deal/D-2026-0892.

Please respond with a rough ETA by EOD Monday so I can confirm the deep-dive time with FinApps.

Thanks — Ben
